units.note: three half-stades (τριῶν ἡμισταδίων) = a stade and a half: correct; 30 cubits correct.

Greek opens mid-sentence (Μακεδόνας πόλεμον) as a seam from ch. 84; English reads on acceptably. 'before making any statement ... to the Achaeans' renders πρὶν ἢ πρὸς τοὺς Ἀχαιοὺς ἀνακαλύπτειν τι τούτων loosely but not wrongly.
